text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waahh! Please teach me some good words~~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Shut uuup! A 'nice phrase'...? Where did 
that come from all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well... as usual, things went kaboom, and 
I had to write an apology letter. But...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I've rewritten this so many times! 
The last one was practically identical to 
the one before...! Yes, I know making the 
same mistake over and over is my fault!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, my letters of apology have 
become so monotonous! Someone, please give 
me a new repertoire of apologies...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I was thinking of casting some magic on 
you depending on how it went, but forget 
it! It's all your fault!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In that case! Allow me to cast a little 
spell—a good luck charm for you♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-san! What matters most in an 
apology letter is a sincere apology and 
facing your mistakes with heart! Borrowing 
someone else's words? Nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Besides, using the same words just means 
you've always apologized honestly in your 
own words. Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with sticking to a 
routine! Be brave! I'm cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san...! That's... you're right! I 
was mistaken! Bring on the routine! I'll 
write this apology letter fair and square 
with pride!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmph, a good luck charm, huh? Not bad 
at all."
